result.title: Google Earth AI Geospatial Reasoning Agent: Capabilities and a Systematic Evaluation
result.comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables (10 main tables, 1 appendix table)
result.summary: Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. GeoExpertQueries poses complex analytical problems grounded in practitioner use cases and refined by geospatial experts; each is paired with a consensus golden workflow from three independent experts and scored by a human-validated, tool-agnostic autorater. GeoKTools consists of templated queries with deterministic reference solvers that systematically vary the number of required tool types. We also use two external benchmarks, CBGB and UnivEARTH; the latter we find to be saturated. To isolate the contribution of GRA's tools and its agentic orchestration, we compare four configurations, each with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash: a standalone LLM, the LLM with basic tools, the LLM with GRA's skills and tools but without its upfront planning and execution guidance, and GRA itself. With at most basic tools, an advanced model recovers much of the answer on templated queries but satisfies only a small fraction of the expert workflows on open-ended problems; GRA performs well on both. The largest step comes from GRA's skills and tools; on open-ended problems, its planning and execution guidance add a further gain with Gemini 3.8 Flash, letting Flash match or exceed Pro at lower cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出由 Gemini 驱动的地理空间推理 agent（GRA），将地理数据源、基础模型与工具组织为模块化技能并配以前置空间规划来分解多阶段查询，同时构建 GeoExpertQueries、GeoKTools 两个基准，并用四种配置比较以拆解工具与 agent 编排各自的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其前置规划加模块化技能的编排方式，以及隔离工具、技能与规划贡献的四配置消融，可供核查 LVR 中推理路径的贡献分配与容忍多种有效工作流的评价设计；但论文本身不涉及内部 latent 状态，属方法线索而非主线研究。
